name: Whimsical
tagline: Fast collaborative flowcharts, wireframes, mind maps, and docs

pricing.notes: Official pricing/help checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $12/editor/month monthly and $10/editor/month annually.

verdictSummary: A constrained diagramming tool with nodes, connectors, sticky notes, and export is a very vibecodable core loop; polish and collaboration are what you lose.
coreLoopDIY: Create a canvas with node shapes, connectors, auto-layout hints, text editing, and PNG/SVG export.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for speed and tidy diagrams that teammates can edit without setup.

priorArt.name: Excalidraw
priorArt.desc: Open-source virtual whiteboard with diagramming, shapes, collaboration options, and export

notes: A good yes/kinda boundary; I marked yes because the constrained core is reachable.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Whimsical (Fast collaborative flowcharts, wireframes, mind maps, and docs). Requirements:

- Core loop: Create a canvas with node shapes, connectors, auto-layout hints, text editing, and PNG/SVG export.
- Needs: React canvas/SVG library.
- Needs: local storage or backend.
- Needs: optional real-time sync.
- Needs: export library.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: templates; multiplayer polish; docs integration.
